analyst_note: All refuted findings are dismissed as non-material to the imminent Phase 3 topline catalyst. The three moderate-severity biomarker claims (vtvt_006, vtvt_027, vtvt_032) cite nonclinical mechanistic data (glucokinase activity, hepatic glucose uptake) as rationale for investigating glycemic control, but this is standard scientific background accompanying a randomized pivotal trial with hard clinical endpoints (hypoglycemia incidence), not a misrepresentation of the catalyst trial's evidence basis. The six minor-severity timeline findings (vtvt_012, vtvt_013, vtvt_016, vtvt_019, vtvt_020, vtvt_022) flag a 15-month slip from the original 2025-06 target to the current 2026-09 primary completion date, but all marketing statements align with the updated publicly registered timeline; omitting slip history in guidance is routine IR practice and does not constitute operational masking. No company-level honesty issues were identified, and no catalyst-trial-specific masking signals are present. The marketing is consistent with an honest sponsor heading into a binary readout.
